author: nanouai
title: Insurance and contract renewals
blurb: Renewals spotted in your mail, options compared, reminders before the deadline.
sample: Your car insurance renews on 1 March at €612, up €80 on last year.
firstMessage: Find my insurance and contract renewals in my mail (car, home, internet, energy), list them with their renewal dates and prices, and remind me a month before each one.
